```yaml
name: SDK CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  validate-sdk-generation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v3
        with:
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync

      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9

      - name: Generate SDK
        run: uv run hatch run server:sdk-generate

      - name: Validate SDK structure
        run: |
          if [ ! -d "sdk/typescript" ]; then
            echo "SDK directory not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ ! -f "sdk/typescript/package.json" ]; then
            echo "package.json not found in SDK"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Install SDK dependencies
        working-directory: sdk/typescript
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Typecheck SDK
        working-directory: sdk/typescript
        run: pnpm typecheck

  validate-version-sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v3
        with:
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Extract version from pyproject.toml
        id: py-version
        run: |
          VERSION=$(uv run python -c "import tomllib; print(tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml', 'rb'))['project']['version'])")
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Validate SDK package version matches
        run: |
          if [ -f "sdk/typescript/package.json" ]; then
            SDK_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./sdk/typescript/package.json').version")
            if [ "$SDK_VERSION" != "${{ steps.py-version.outputs.version }}" ]; then
              echo "Version mismatch: pyproject.toml=${{ steps.py-version.outputs.version }}, SDK=$SDK_VERSION"
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "Versions match: ${{ steps.py-version.outputs.version }}"
          else
            echo "SDK package.json not found, skipping version check"
          fi
```
